hook: Pain after eating? Where it hurts matters.

slides.main: Stomach pain after meals? 4 patterns that can point to the cause.
slides.sub: Where, when and how it hurts, and when to get help.

slides.main: Burning or fullness during or soon after a meal can point towards indigestion.
slides.sub: Most chronic indigestion is functional dyspepsia: real symptoms, but no other cause found.

slides.main: Severe, constant pain after heavy meals can be gallstones.
slides.sub: Pain lasting longer than 30 minutes deserves an urgent GP appointment.

slides.main: Food intolerance symptoms usually start a few hours after eating.
slides.sub: So the meal you ate last is not always the one to blame.

slides.main: Pain that eases after a bowel movement is a key IBS symptom.
slides.sub: With IBS the pain can be anywhere in the tummy and can move around.

slides.main: Get medical help if you have:
items: Blood in your stool or black stools
